address: Weserstraße 4, Frankfurt on the Main, 60329, Germany
bio: Having already proved their culinary credentials in their restaurants Weinsinn and Gustav (now closed), Matthias Scheiber and Milica Trajkovska Scheiber have created an exciting new concept here on the premises of Weinsinn – a kind of fusion of their previous ventures. The atmosphere is airy, inviting and friendly. Done out in Bauhaus style, the chic, upscale interior features various artistic details that provide decorative touches. The open kitchen turns out a diverse range of highly distinctive seasonal dishes. These are ingredient-led and pared down to a few components, a case in point being the grilled pointed cabbage, fermented mushroom broth, cremini mushroom and smoked egg yolk.
